question: What is your experience in fine art?
answer: We have been passionate collectors of fine 19th century art for over 25 years, developing relationships with art galleries, museums, auctioneer houses, conservators and knowledgeable collectors. As collectors ourselves, we do our due diligence in researching each artist and examples of their work.
more: Some of our paintings have been requested for museum art exhibitions and some have appeared in magazines and books. We are on the board of Southern Alleghenies Museum of Art and guide the selection of new art acquisitions.
